about_the_game:
Ascending to Immortal "is a 2D horizontal board cultivation game. The protagonist grew up in a town at the foot of Xianshan Mountain, with average qualifications and no ability to cultivate immortality. By chance, he found his ancestral secret script and unexpectedly embarked on the path of cultivating immortality. Frequent spiritual energy fluctuations occur in the mountains and forests, as if a gateway to a different realm has opened in an uninhabited area. Countless cultivators flock here, unsure whether this is an opportunity or a danger ...

Ten thousand years ago, the spiritual energy of the mainland was abundant. Some talented individuals awakened and absorbed the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, supplemented with elixirs, operated the heavens, broke through the realm of cultivation, and ascended to immortality. For a time, cultivators flocked to it, and everyone competed to cultivate immortality. However, the spiritual energy gradually disappeared through countless cultivators' absorption and refinement, and no one has been able to reach the realm of ascension for thousands of years. The number of high-level cultivators with great power is also limited. After thousands of years of reincarnation, the spiritual energy has gradually rebounded in recent decades, and various forces are also secretly stirring up.

This game is a seasonal update, a horizontal board cultivation adventure game. In the game, players can freely trade and continuously obtain materials, improve equipment, cultivate characters to break through levels, and ascend to immortality as soon as possible by fighting monsters.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes some sexy clothing such as swimsuits and cheongsams, but these clothes do not expose women's breasts and genitals

In this era of sparse spiritual energy, in this gradually recovering spiritual forest, it will be your last chance to embark on the path of immortality.
